description: Asks how often Rnd and Now are sampled: two Rnd() occurrences per row over Den (run twice), Rnd(Id), Rnd(-1)/Rnd()/Rnd(0) in one projection (run twice), a lone Rnd(-1) (run twice), and two Now() occurrences per row. The returned values and their tags are captured; repeats show the shape. Fixture r-expr-1-main2 is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-expr-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
